# Kyoto 5-Day Relaxed Trip Plan

A calm, photo-friendly itinerary for **2 adults** from **2026-11-03 to 2026-11-07** with temples, local food, and one easy evening activity. I’ve kept each day to **3 major activities max**, added an **afternoon rest block**, and stayed within your **JPY 180,000 total budget** target.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

## Day 1 — Tue, Nov 3: Higashiyama First Impressions
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive in Kyoto, check in, and settle near Kyoto Station or Higashiyama for easy transit.
- **Late morning:** **Kiyomizu-dera** for classic city views and early photos.
- **Afternoon rest:** Coffee break + hotel downtime; keep the pace slow after travel.
- **Evening:** Walk **Sannenzaka / Ninenzaka** at dusk, then a simple kaiseki or tofu dinner.
- **Estimated transit:** 20–35 min local transfers
- **Approx. cost for 2:** **JPY 24,000–32,000**
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto National Museum + café time in the Higashiyama area.

## Day 2 — Wed, Nov 4: Arashiyama and Riverside Scenery
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** early, before crowds.
- **Late morning:** **Tenryu-ji** and its garden for temple photography.
- **Afternoon rest:** Slow lunch near the river, then return to the hotel for downtime.
- **Evening:** Gentle **Katsura River** or Togetsukyo bridge stroll; low-key and easy.
- **Estimated transit:** 35–55 min each way from central Kyoto
- **Approx. cost for 2:** **JPY 26,000–36,000**
- **Rainy-day backup:** Arashiyama Monkey Park can be skipped; instead do **Saga-Arashiyama Station area**, tea shops, and a temple-focused indoor visit.

## Day 3 — Thu, Nov 5: Northern Kyoto Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** **Kinkaku-ji** for the golden pavilion and garden photos.
- **Late morning:** **Ryoan-ji** for the rock garden and a quieter temple stop.
- **Afternoon rest:** Return to central Kyoto for lunch and a proper break.
- **Evening:** Casual **Pontocho** or **Kiyamachi** dinner walk, then head back early.
- **Estimated transit:** 25–45 min total between sites, depending on base
- **Approx. cost for 2:** **JPY 22,000–30,000**
- **Rainy-day backup:** Add **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** or a tea-house stop instead of extended outdoor walking.

## Day 4 — Fri, Nov 6: Fushimi Inari and Local Eats
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Morning:** **Fushimi Inari Taisha** very early for photos and lighter crowds.
- **Late morning:** Explore a shorter section of the torii trail rather than doing the full hike.
- **Afternoon rest:** Lunch in the Fushimi area, then hotel downtime.
- **Evening:** Easy food-focused outing: **izakaya**, **yakitori**, or **ramen** near Kyoto Station.
- **Estimated transit:** 15–30 min each way from central Kyoto
- **Approx. cost for 2:** **JPY 20,000–28,000**
- **Rainy-day backup:** Keep the shrine visit brief and shift the rest of the day to **Kyoto Station food hall** and indoor shopping arcades.

## Day 5 — Sat, Nov 7: Central Kyoto and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Slow breakfast, then **Nishiki Market** for food browsing and souvenirs.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning:** Slow breakfast, then **Nishiki Market** for food browsing and souvenirs, Kyoto, Japan
- **Late morning:** Optional short temple stop such as **Nanzen-ji** or **Honen-in** if timing allows.
Media: Alt=Late morning:** Optional short temple stop such as **Nanzen-ji** or **Honen-in** if timing allows, Kyoto, Japan
- **Afternoon rest:** Pack, rest, and allow buffer for airport or train transfer.
- **Evening:** Departure or last meal near your station if schedule permits.
- **Estimated transit:** 10–30 min local transfers
- **Approx. cost for 2:** **JPY 18,000–26,000**
- **Rainy-day backup:** Make this a mostly indoor day with **Nishiki Market**, department-store food floors, and station-area cafés.

# Budget Fit and Pace Check

| Day | Main Focus | Transit Time | Approx. Cost for 2 | Rain Backup |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Nov 3 | Higashiyama temples + old streets | 20–35 min | JPY 24,000–32,000 | Museum + café time |
| Nov 4 | Arashiyama gardens + river | 35–55 min | JPY 26,000–36,000 | Indoor temple/tea stop |
| Nov 5 | Northern Kyoto temple circuit | 25–45 min | JPY 22,000–30,000 | Museum or tea house |
| Nov 6 | Fushimi Inari + food evening | 15–30 min | JPY 20,000–28,000 | Station food hall |
| Nov 7 | Nishiki Market + easy close | 10–30 min | JPY 18,000–26,000 | Mostly indoor market day |

**Estimated total for 5 days:** **JPY 110,000–152,000** for 2 adults
This leaves a comfortable buffer under your **JPY 180,000** cap for nicer meals, extra taxis, admission upgrades, and souvenirs.
